title: Associated sheaf of an injective module over a Noetherian ring is flasque
statement: Let R be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and M an injective R-module. The presheaf of R-modules (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj (tilde M)).presheaf on Spec R [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] is flasque: every restriction morphism is an epimorphism, equivalently a surjection of underlying sets. No locality or choice of puncture is assumed.

source.place: Tag 09T2, Lemma 36.8.1; affine equivalence between modules and quasi-coherent sheaves

proof.text: On Spec R form the ideal-sheaf data I of the reduced closed complement of U. Apply quasicoherent_open_section_ideal_extension to tilde M and s. This supplies a power K = I^n and alpha:K.toModules -> tilde M whose restriction is multiplication by s. Transport the global ideal K(top) along GammaSpecIso.inv to J <= R. The injective global inclusion has range J, so LinearEquiv.ofInjective identifies its source with J. Compose the inverse equivalence, alpha on global sections, and tilde.isoTop.inv to obtain phi:J -> M. Naturality and tilde.toOpen_res give tilde.toOpen M U (phi a) = a*s. The support formula for K shows J is not contained in any prime of U; the zeroth power has empty support.

The inclusion J -> R is monic by ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective. Injective.factors extends phi to psi:R -> M. Put m=psi(1). Linearity and the factorization identity give a*m=phi(a), hence a*tilde.toOpen M U(m)=a*s for every a in J.

At each x in U choose a in J outside x.asIdeal. On V=U intersect D(a), the scalar a acts injectively by Scheme.Modules.isSMulRegular_of_le_basicOpen. Restrict the preceding scalar equality and cancel a on V. TopCat.Presheaf.IsSheaf.section_ext therefore gives tilde.toOpen M U(m)=s. This proves global extension on every open, including the empty open where the local equality condition is vacuous.

For a restriction U -> V in the opposite opens category, extend a section on V globally and restrict that global section to U. The equation tilde.toOpen_res verifies that it maps to the prescribed section on V. ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective converts these surjections into the epi field of TopCat.Presheaf.IsFlasque.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09T2, proof of Lemma 36.8.1, using Tag 01YB through the existing quasicoherent_open_section_ideal_extension theorem; affine coordinate conversion, injective factorization, local scalar cancellation and arbitrary-open restriction written in Lean by T2.

lean.statement:
theorem injective_tilde_isFlasque
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) [Injective M] :
    TopCat.Presheaf.IsFlasque (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj (tilde (R := .of R) M)).presheaf
